paragraphs.text: The number of managed honey bee colonies in some regions has fallen sharply, and scientists disagree about the main cause. Professor Lena Hoffmann, an entomologist, believes that a parasitic mite is responsible for most losses, because colonies treated against it survive far more often.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Dr Rafael Soto, who studies farming chemicals, accepts that the mite is important but argues that pesticides weaken bees so that they cannot resist infection. In his experiments, bees exposed to small amounts of one common pesticide found their way back to the hive less reliably.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Beekeeper and author Grace Mills takes a different view. In her experience, the loss of wild flowers on farmland leaves bees without a varied diet, and poorly fed colonies are the first to die in winter. She has persuaded several farmers near her hives to sow strips of flowers along their fields.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Hoffmann warns against looking for a single villain. She notes that colonies facing several problems at once collapse much faster than those facing only one, and she calls for research that studies the causes together.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: She has persuaded several farmers near her hives to sow strips of flowers along their fields
items.prompt: has encouraged local changes in how farmland is used

explanation.en: Mills “has persuaded several farmers … to sow strips of flowers” — a change in how land is used → C.
explanation.kk: Миллс «has persuaded several farmers … to sow strips of flowers» — жерді пайдалануды өзгерту деген осы → C.
explanation.ru: Миллс «has persuaded several farmers … to sow strips of flowers» — это и есть изменение использования земли → C.

items.quote: bees exposed to small amounts of one common pesticide found their way back to the hive less reliably
items.prompt: describes how a chemical affected bees’ ability to find their way

explanation.en: In Soto’s experiments, bees exposed to pesticide “found their way back to the hive less reliably” → B. Hoffmann talks about the mite, not chemicals.
explanation.kk: Сото тәжірибесінде пестицидтен кейін аралар «found their way back to the hive less reliably» → B. Хоффман химия емес, кене туралы айтады.
explanation.ru: В опытах Сото пчёлы после пестицида «found their way back to the hive less reliably» → B. Хоффман говорит о клеще, а не о химии.

items.quote: a parasitic mite is responsible for most losses
items.prompt: believes a parasite causes most of the losses

explanation.en: Hoffmann: “a parasitic mite is responsible for most losses” → A. Soto also accepts the mite matters, but blames pesticides most.
explanation.kk: Хоффман: «a parasitic mite is responsible for most losses» → A. Сото да кененің рөлін мойындайды, бірақ басты себеп деп пестицидті санайды.
explanation.ru: Хоффман: «a parasitic mite is responsible for most losses» → A. Сото тоже признаёт роль клеща, но главной причиной считает пестициды.

items.quote: colonies facing several problems at once collapse much faster than those facing only one
items.prompt: suggests that several problems together are especially harmful

explanation.en: In paragraph D Hoffmann notes that colonies with several problems “collapse much faster” → A. A repeats — the instruction has an NB.
explanation.kk: D абзацында Хоффман бірнеше мәселесі бар ұялар «collapse much faster» дейді → A. A әрпі қайталанады — нұсқаулықта NB бар.
explanation.ru: В абзаце D Хоффман замечает, что семьи с несколькими проблемами «collapse much faster» → A. Буква A повторяется — в инструкции есть NB.

items.quote: the loss of wild flowers on farmland leaves bees without a varied diet
items.prompt: links bee deaths to a lack of variety in their food

explanation.en: Mills: without wild flowers bees lack “a varied diet”, and poorly fed colonies die first → C.
explanation.kk: Миллс: жабайы гүл болмаса, араларда «a varied diet» жоқ, нашар қоректенген ұялар бірінші өледі → C.
explanation.ru: Миллс: без диких цветов у пчёл нет «a varied diet», и плохо накормленные семьи гибнут первыми → C.
